title: Justice Tracker
description: Public-facing documentation of incidents, victims, timelines, and case status in Bangladesh.

hero.headline: We count. We remember. We don't forget.
hero.subtitle: In Bangladesh, 3 rape cases are filed every day—ones we forget. So that we don't forget.

paragraphs.rape: In Bangladesh, an average of 3 rape cases are filed every day—most of which we forget. We document each incident. We follow every case from report to verdict. So that none stay in the dark.
paragraphs.extortion: In Bangladesh, an average of 8–9 extortion cases are filed every day. We track the numbers and keep sources and outcomes on record. So there is accountability and so we don't forget.
paragraphs.murder: In Bangladesh, more than 11 murder cases are filed every day on average. We document each case from filing to verdict. An open resource for truth and justice.
paragraphs.kidnapping: In Bangladesh, an average of 2–3 kidnapping cases are filed every day. We record each incident and track data by district and division. So that no case is forgotten and transparency is maintained.

document.title: Document
document.body: We record incidents with dates, locations, and sources so nothing is forgotten.

track.title: Track
track.body: Follow each case from report to verdict across divisions and districts.

accountability.title: Accountability
accountability.body: Transparent timelines and outcomes help communities seek justice.

cta.heading: Stay informed
cta.body: Browse incidents by district and status. Share this resource with others who care about accountability.
